messages:
jess_prod: Quick sync — LargeBank + two fintechs pushed a combined ask: EU data residency, SSO for admin UI, and an opt-in canary path for Scoped Flags v2. I'm proposing an EU-first staged rollout with a tight fallback. Need alignment on scope (what to ship in phase 1), canary sizing, launch gates, and a fallback playbook. Who's available for a short decision thread?

alex_cheng: +1 — EU-first makes sense for residency. Two quick tradeoffs: SSO adds ~3w of work (ok to defer to phase 2?), and supporting a lower-precision fallback (quantized model) will reduce cost but may hurt p95. For phase 1 I'd suggest: internal 5% (internal apps), then 10% external opt-in cohort.

maria_garcia: If we do opt-in, we need clear consent and comms. I'd own the customer-facing email + docs. Also recommend we require an admin toggle per-tenant and a visible status page for enrolled customers.

samir_n: Ops notes: EU pool needs dedicated capacity + KMS config. Warmup + autoscaling expected ~48h. Canary schedule that staggers capacity is important. Proposed timeline:
- Day 0: internal 5% (canary)
- Day 2: open 10% external opt-in (select customers)
- Day 14: evaluate, expand to 40% if metrics OK
Kill switch: immediate route to baseline model + alert to #eng-oncall.

alex_cheng: Suggested launch gates (hard):
- errors: <0.5% (5xx + model-fails)
- p95 latency: <150ms increase vs baseline
- token cost delta: <10% (per-token cost)
- quality regression: A/B diff on our eval set < 2% drop in rouge/embedding-similarity
If any gate fails, rollback to baseline for the cohort.

jess_prod: Sounds good. On scope: I propose we ship phase 1 without SSO (phase 2), but include per-tenant toggle + audit logs + residency pin for EU. That reduces time-to-launch. Anyone object?

elliot: I'll run the A/B analysis and set up the evaluation dashboards. Need a baseline query set from product (I'll take 50 representative prompts).

product-ops: Please add the policy for fallback routing in the runbook. Minimal playbook:
1) Detect (alert on gate breach)
2) Auto-route impacted tenants to baseline model
3) Notify stakeholders (ops, product, customer success)
4) Postmortem trigger if >30 minutes outage
Also add a customer opt-out flow.

alex_cheng: Quick config example for the flag (ops-friendly):
```
flag: scoped_flags_v2
region: eu-west-1
phase1: internal=5%, external_optin=10%
fallback: route_to=baseline_v1, alert_channel=#eng-oncall
metrics: p95_latency, error_rate, cost_delta, quality_delta
```

jess_prod: Ok — decision for today: ship phase 1 without SSO, include residency pin + per-tenant toggle, run internal 5% canary then 10% external opt-in for 14 days, gates as Alex listed, fallback playbook as product-ops wrote. Action items:
- Alex: finalize latency/regression thresholds + QA plan
- Samir: provision EU capacity + deploy runbook hooks
- Maria: draft customer comms + opt-in flow copy
- Elliot: evaluation dashboards + query set
I'll set up a 30m sync for tomorrow 10am to confirm timelines. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist: all required PRs merged, infra tickets linked, canary-runbook.md added. https://ci.redwood.internal/12345

maria_garcia: ACK, will share draft by EOD and ping CS for LargeBank coordination.

samir_n: Provisioning started, ETA for EU pool: 72h. Will add autoscale knobs for canary.

alex_cheng: I'll draft the QA checklist and a short rollback script for ops.

jess_prod: Thanks all — if nobody raises objections by EOD we'll lock scope and start work tomorrow.
